description: This polygon layer identifies extents in which listed aquatic species and protected critical habitat may occur. The source explicitly states that habitat-protection prohibitions can restrict development and construction and directs users to Fisheries and Oceans Canada for projects near water. The polygons combine federal habitat information with Alberta hydrology and a larger surrounding buffer, so they are not exact habitat boundaries. Inclusion is limited to the source-defined construction-constraint role. HTML/XML descriptors, unstated dates and uninspected legal instruments prevent any claim of current site-specific legal clearance. Geographic coverage is Alberta. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue carries the Alberta source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Native licence statements are Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual access and costs remain unverified. HEAD checks returned 200 for the CUDC landing page and 403 for the original Alberta landing page.
